photos.desc: In situ teeth of the unenlagiine theropod Buitreraptor gonzalezorum Makovicky, Apesteguía, and Agnolín, 2005 (MPCA 245) from the Upper Creta−ceous of La Buitrera, northwestern Río Negro, Argentina. A.
Dorsal (A) and medial (B) views of Buitreraptor gonzalezorum pes showing slender and gracile metatarsals, sub-equal lengths of metatarsals II and IV, and modified digit II (MPCA-PV-598);
Illustration of the dromaeosaurid dinosaur Buitreraptor , found in South America , dated to be about 90 million years old.
Andesaurus , Giganotosaurus , Ekrixinatosaurus , Limaysaurus , Araripesuchus , and Buitreraptor .
